subject: Packaging and transfer options for admin-activity evidence (SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ)
messages:
From: Gina Park <gpark@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Admin activity evidence — what you can deliver for SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG and SOC 2 evidence collection we need a clear statement of what admin-activity is captured by Redwood, retention windows, and practical export/transfer options. Specific asks from our auditors: a) canonical list of admin event types (console/API/admin-key changes, role changes, session/logins, model/endpoint deploys, routing config changes, deletion events), b) retention defaults and options for 90/365/730 days, c) export formats (CSV/JSON/NDJSON), and d) chain-of-custody + signed manifest options for delivered snapshots.

Also: can you support direct S3 delivery to our bucket or a signed, time-limited transfer? Any PGP/PKI signing you offer is helpful. If you have a short deliverable list and an example export manifest I can share with the team.

We are on a tight schedule for our SIG submission — ideally we want an export ready by end of next month.

Best,
Gina
Senior Compliance Manager
BrightPath Health

---
Attachment: request_checklist.txt (text)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Gina Park <gpark@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence — what you can deliver for SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ

Hi Gina — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise mapping of what Redwood records and the options we can provide for packaging and transfer. I attached a sample schema CSV and a short playbook with step-by-step transfer options.

1) Events we capture (canonical):
- Console/admin UI logins (timestamp, actor_id, ip, user_agent)
- API authentication events (token issuance, token revoke)
- Role and permission changes (who, before/after, timestamp)
- Admin key creation/rotation/deletion (key_id, actor, timestamp)
- Model/endpoint lifecycle events (deploy, rollback, version, image_digest)
- Routing & policy changes (policy_id, previous, updated_fields)
- Billing/plan changes (who, change_summary)
- Data access events for admin tools (recorded when admins export customer artifacts)
- Deletion requests and retention policy modifications

2) Retention: default hosted retention is 90 days for admin activity. Options:
- 90 days (default)
- 365 days (extended, additional cost)
- Customer-managed long term storage: daily snapshot export delivered to customer bucket (contracted).

3) Export formats & packaging:
- NDJSON (preferred for large exports) and CSV (fields consistent with attached schema)
- gzipped JSONL bundles (chunked by day)
- Signed manifest: SHA256 checksums for each bundle, manifest.json with bundle names/timestamps/sha256
- Optional PGP signing of manifest or GPG-encrypted archive for transport

4) Transfer methods:
- Direct S3 PUT to a customer-provided bucket (Cross-account role) — preferred for automated handoffs
- Time-limited pre-signed URLs (https) for manual download
- SFTP with upload keys (enterprise only)
- For air-gapped/large datasets: encrypted shipping of a Snowball or equivalent (legal/procurement lead time required)

5) Chain-of-custody and attestation:
- We can provide a signed manifest, export playbook PDF with checksums, and a transfer log showing the job id and operator.
- For SOC 2 evidence we recommend: manifest + sample logs + statement of export configuration (retention window, filters applied).

6) Sampling & PII handling:
- We can run export filters by date ranges, by admin actor, or by event type.
- We can pseudonymize internal actor IDs on request and provide a mapping key under an NDA.

Next steps: please confirm desired retention window and preferred transfer method + your bucket name/role if you want S3 delivery. I attached admin_activity_schema.csv and export_playbook.pdf (summary of the above with example commands).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Security & Compliance (Sales Ops liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_schema.csv, export_playbook.pdf
From: Gina Park <gpark@brightpathhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence — what you can deliver for SOC 2/SIG/CAIQ

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks — that is very helpful. A couple of clarifying questions from our security team:
- Can you include KMS/HSM key rotation audit events (issuer, key_id, key_version) in the export or are those held by our KMS provider?
- For direct S3 delivery, do you require us to add a cross-account role or do you accept pre-signed PUT URLs for each file? We prefer cross-account role but need your documented steps.
- Will the export manifest include the full object size so our intake pipeline can validate completeness?

We would like 365-day retention for this project and automated daily snapshots delivered to our S3 bucket (we will share bucket ARN and cross-account role). Target delivery window: first complete snapshot by Aug 1.

Gina

Hi Gina — quick technical responses:
- KMS/HSM audit events: we record when keys are referenced by platform services and capture key_id + operation. Full HSM vendor logs remain with the KMS provider; we can include the platform-side events and cross-reference vendor log ids in the manifest.
- S3 transfer: we support both cross-account role (recommended) and pre-signed multipart PUTs for large bundles. The cross-account role reduces operational overhead. I added a short checklist to the attached transfer_manifest-20250721.jsonl.gz showing the manifest format we will produce and the fields your intake pipeline should validate (object_name, size_bytes, sha256, job_id, exported_at).
- Manifest fields will include size_bytes and sha256 for every object so you can validate completeness.

We can enable 365-day retention for your tenant and kick off daily exports to the bucket you will provide. Please share the S3 ARN + role trust policy and we will schedule the first export job for 2025-08-01 02:00 UTC.

If you'd like, Connor can run a short handoff call on Thursday to walk through the intake validation.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
